title: CityParquet city metadata
description: Parquet footer key-value metadata carried under the `city` key (../../../documents/docs/03-specification/05-metadata.mdx, "The `city` object"). Describes the Parquet file it lives in; requirements depend on the file's role (object table vs. sidecar) as described in the prose spec — this schema validates the shape every `city` object (of either role) must have, not the conditional cross-field rules beyond `columns` => `primary_column`.

version.description: CityParquet format version, e.g. "0.1.0-draft" (see the dataset-package spec's Versioning section).

source_format.description: Provenance: "CityJSON", "CityJSONSeq", "CityGML", or any other open-ended source token (e.g. "3DCityDB") this document doesn't enumerate. Omitted entirely, not a placeholder value, when a table has no single source.

source_version.description: Source schema version (e.g. CityJSON 2.0), when there is a source.

crs.description: The file CRS as PROJJSON. Required (in the prose spec, not enforced here) whenever the file holds any CRS-bearing coordinate. Loosely typed: this schema does not validate full PROJJSON structure.

primary_column.description: Name of the primary geometry column used with no LoD preference. MAY name a Solid column; independent of geo.primary_column.

columns.description: One entry per geometry column -- every geometry column, Solid-family included. Present only when the table has any geometry column (a sidecar with no geometry omits this key entirely rather than writing an empty array).

encoding.description: "WKB" -- the only encoding CityParquet supports at present.

geometry_types.description: The WKB types present in the column, each with the 3D " Z" suffix. May name Solid-family types (which geo may not).

crs.description: PROJJSON; defaults to the file-level city.crs when absent.

orientation_3d.description: 3D surface winding. A conforming writer states this explicitly on every entry.

edges.description: CityParquet coordinates are Cartesian in a projected CRS.

bbox.description: Dataset-level bounding box of the column's geometries. Loosely typed -- not yet populated by this writer.

epoch.description: Coordinate epoch (decimal year) for a dynamic CRS, when relevant.

attributes.description: The list of inferred attribute columns (object tables). Present only when the table has any (omitted, not an empty array, otherwise).

extensions.description: Extension / ADE declarations: the real declaration JSON plus a source-name/class/module mapping. Loosely typed -- the spec leaves the internal shape open.

appearance_defaults.description: Source default material / texture theme, when present.

other.description: Free-form object for anything not covered above. Informational only: a reader MUST NOT need this to decode the file.

then.description: primary_column is required whenever the table has any geometry column (05-metadata.mdx).
